objective: Run three published retrieval-augmented forecasting systems in their native released settings and pair every retrieval result with the corresponding native no-retrieval base.

reporting_boundary.reason: The systems use different backbones, datasets, horizons, splits, and metrics. Each row is compared only with its native base.

ts_rag.checkpoint_gate: Record the downloaded TS-RAG checkpoint SHA-256 before the first inference cell. The same released Chronos-Bolt weights and test split must be used for the paired base.

released_config_correction.basis: The paper and every other Benchmark I configuration use C in {50,75,100,150}; the first ETTh entry is a duplicate typo.

raf.memory_safe_execution: Embed candidate windows in bounded chunks and retain the exact running top-1 under the released L2 distance. This is algebraically equivalent to materializing the full query-by-candidate matrix and is required because the released implementation requests more than 22 GiB for one ETTh candidate batch on an A10G.

ratd.released_code_boundary: The released Electricity command uses history 96 and horizon 168, although the paper states history 168 and horizons 96, 192, and 336. Report this as the released-code setting, not as a reproduction of the paper aggregate.
required_repairs: Replace hard-coded author filesystem paths with paths below the canonical EFS project root.
Build every split's query-to-reference mapping against training windows only; a reference future must end inside the training boundary.
Pass the selected reference tensor through every reverse-diffusion sampling step.
Fix the released process_data tuple mismatch and derive feature IDs from the actual target dimension.
Train and evaluate use_reference=true and use_reference=false with identical seeds, splits, architecture settings, and sampling counts.

acceptance.delta_definition: retrieval - base; negative is better for every reported metric

amendments.scope: candidate embedding and nearest-neighbor memory use only
amendments.trigger: The first ETTh C=50 smoke attempt failed before producing a retrieval result when the released implementation tried to allocate 22.79 GiB for one candidate embedding batch.
amendments.change: Stream candidate windows in batches of at most 512 and merge exact per-query top-1 distances after each batch.
